notes.title: New Settings Update
notes.notes:
Time for an thrilling settings update, try to contain your excitement.

Uhh, remade and added some settings, was going to make a before and after settings pic but forgot to take a picture of the before, only the after. Anyway, here's the after:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515864/71e6c34ac600da161813a45144684ea10fbf7e89.png[/img]

[b]Screen Mode[/b]: Instead of a Windowed toggle you can now select between Exclusive Full Screen, Full Screen Window, Maximized Window and Windowed.

[b]Invert Y[/b]: You can now invert up/down controls.

Make sure to get the patch for these explosive new features.
